name: Pdfdodo
summary: Converts PDF bank statements, invoices and receipts, including scans and handwriting, into CSV or Excel tables with OCR, with an API for automated workflows; plans are metered by pages per month.
best_for: bookkeepers, accountants and small businesses that turn bank statements, invoices and receipts in PDF or scan form into spreadsheets a few hundred pages a month
skip_if: you need a full PDF editor rather than table extraction; you process far more than 3000 pages a month; or your documents are mainly in a language outside the six the FAQ lists
honest_knock: The refund rules contradict each other: the FAQ says no refunds of any kind, the terms promise refunds within 30 days of purchase. The yearly Solo card shows $20 a month beside $200 billed yearly, which cannot both be right, and no plan names its currency. Cancelling means sending an email rather than a button in the app.

pricing.entry_price_terms: Solo · billed monthly, 300 pages a month, 15 MB per PDF
pricing.notes: (read 2026-10-16 in a browser on pdfdodo.com, monthly and yearly view of the pricing block; the cards show a $ sign without naming the currency) Four plans metered by pages analysed per month: Free $0 for 25 pages a month and 5 MB per PDF; Solo $25 a month for 300 pages and 15 MB per PDF; Startup $59 a month for 1000 pages and 15 MB per PDF; Business $99 a month for 3000 pages with no upload limit and priority support. Billed yearly the cards show Startup at $49 a month ($590 billed yearly) and Business at $82.5 a month ($990 billed yearly); the Solo card shows $20 a month next to $200 billed yearly, two figures that do not match each other (12 x $20 is $240). The page advertises 2 months free on yearly plans. One page is one credit. The FAQ says no refunds are given, partial or full, while section 8 of the terms says refunds are issued within 30 days of the original purchase.

compare_with.name: Shoeboxed
compare_with.why: Shoeboxed is in our dossiers too and also turns receipts into data, but it is built around a receipt archive, accounting sync and a mailed envelope of paper that people digitise; its Starter plan was $9 a month for 50 digital scans when we read it on 11 October 2026. Pdfdodo only extracts tables from PDFs and images into CSV or Excel, and meters pages rather than receipts.

sessions.what: Tested by our team on 6 November 2026 on the free plan: Daan created the account and our AI assistant ran the test in Daan's browser. We converted our fictional invoice from the test kit into a PDF, uploaded it, ran the analysis and read the result and the pricing page. We downloaded nothing and did not open checkout.
findings: Sign-up asked for no card. The dashboard showed 25 credits and a 15 MB limit per file. The page says you can download results as CSV or Excel.
Upload, 'Start Analysis' and 'Analysis complete' took about 15 seconds. The credit counter then read 24.

The document detail page showed only the file name, the date and a 'Merge tables' menu. It held no table and no value, and we saw no download button. No error or warning appeared, yet the analysis had used a credit.

Our invoice lists its lines as plain text (date, amount, custom code, tags, net, tax) and has no table. The app extracts tables, so for this layout we got nothing: none of the seven fields was read out. This is a result for one document of this type, not a measure of accuracy on invoices with tables.
A missing 'ë' in the sample name was already empty in the test image, so we do not count it as a reading error.

The pricing page opens with 'Yearly' highlighted while the cards show monthly prices: Solo $25, Startup $59 and Business $99 a month. After clicking 'Monthly' the cards show the yearly prices: Solo $20.83 a month ($250 billed yearly), Startup $49.16 ($590) and Business $82.50 ($990). On 16 October the Solo card read $20 beside $200, so that card changed.
not_tested: Export and re-import: the analysis produced no table, so there was nothing to export, and we downloaded no file
The second fictional record: we uploaded one document
Checkout, tax and the final price: we did not click Select
Support, team roles, API access, invitations, downgrade and cancellation
Whether the monthly credit top-up exists; we saw 25 credits and no refill rule
sessions.note: Findings as written up after the session; no pass/fail per task was scored.
